name: Unitree R1
description: Compact, lightweight humanoid from Unitree, sold in AIR, Standard, and EDU configurations spanning hobbyist to research/development budgets. Smaller and far cheaper than the G1, aimed at education and secondary development.

specs.label: Compute
specs.note: EDU adds Jetson Orin NX, 40 TOPS

specs.label: Degrees of Freedom
specs.note: AIR: 20 · Standard: 26 · EDU: up to 40 w/ hands

sourcing: Specs sourced from Unitree's official R1 product page and cross-checked against RoboStore's EDU listing, as of September 2026. robotindex does not sell this product — pricing shown is for reference and may vary by configuration and retailer.

pricing.summary: From **$4,900** (AIR). Standard configuration is $5,900; EDU (with Jetson Orin NX and optional dexterous hands) runs around $15,950 per retailer listings — Unitree's own site lists EDU as contact-for-price.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Base AIR: monocular camera, 20 DOF. Standard/EDU add a binocular depth camera, 2-DOF waist, 2-DOF head (26 DOF total, up to 40 with EDU's optional dexterous hand). All variants include a 4-mic array, stereo speakers, joint encoders, and PMSM joint motors with air cooling. EDU adds an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX for onboard AI compute. No 3D LiDAR included.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: No recalls, lawsuits, safety incidents, or data-privacy reports were found for the Unitree R1 in the sources reviewed here.
